title: Tsiolkovsky rocket equation
references: Sutton, G. P. and Biblarz, O., Rocket Propulsion Elements, 9th ed., Wiley (2016)
Kleppner, D. and Kolenkow, R. J., An Introduction to Mechanics, 2nd ed., Cambridge University Press (2014)
validity_domain: Non-relativistic rocket with constant effective exhaust speed ve, burning from initial mass m0 to final mass mf, with no external force.
limitations: Gravity, drag and any other external force lower the achievable change of speed below this value
Non-relativistic: not valid when the speed approaches c
The masses are ordered in the formula (larger over smaller), so that swapped inputs never give a false IMPOSSIBLE; m0 is the mass before the burn
A bound of an idealized rocket, not a figure that a real vehicle reaches

variables.ve: Effective exhaust speed relative to the rocket
variables.mf: Final total mass after the burn
